name.en-US: All for Jesus, or the Easy Ways of Divine Love
name.pt-BR: Tudo por Jesus, ou os Caminhos Fáceis do Amor Divino

description.en-US: Faber's first great devotional treatise (1853), written for the Confraternity of the Precious Blood: nine chapters on loving Jesus by taking up His interests, sympathizing with Him in His sorrows, offering Him reparation, and winning souls, with a closing chapter on devotion to the souls in purgatory and a letter to the Confraternity.
description.pt-BR: O primeiro grande tratado devocional de Faber (1853), escrito para a Confraria do Preciosíssimo Sangue: nove capítulos sobre o amor a Jesus — tomar a peito os Seus interesses, compadecer-se das Suas dores, oferecer-Lhe reparação e ganhar almas —, com um capítulo final sobre a devoção às almas do purgatório e uma carta à Confraria.

en-US.editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1853)

sources.edition: All for Jesus, or the Easy Ways of Divine Love (London and Derby: Richardson and Son, 1853), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The prefaces to the first four editions are given as one preface; the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fr. Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1853, so the text is public domain.
